column5: The editor activity overview homepage (Welcome, LUANHUYNH999). Includes 6 statistical indicators (managed series, manuscripts requiring attention, deadline warnings, monthly approvals, critical delay alerts, and series at risk), quick access link, and recent notification log.
Displays a list of all system notifications, filtered by tabs (All, Unread, From Author, From Council, System). Supports mark-as-read, delete action, and quick navigation to resolve tasks.
Comprehensive management list of assigned manga series. Displays series title, genre, publication status (In Progress, Published), total views, and series creation date.
Tracks detailed progress of chapter pages under managed series in an accordion view. Displays drawing progress percentage (%), expected release date, page count, and quick manuscript view button.
column9: Renamed deadline column to expected release date and integrated virtual chapter display

column5: Review interface for manuscripts submitted by Mangakas, separated into two tabs: 'Review New Series' (approval for production start) and 'Review Manuscript' (checking chapter drafts). Supports viewing drafts and creating page annotations with feedback comments.
Visualizes series approval progress diagram through 5 main workflow steps and manages recommendations up to the Board Council.
Shows ranking catalog (Views and Likes) for managed series and evaluates performance parameters.
Displays delay alerts and warnings for story progress. Allows generating and sending deadline reminder alerts to the Mangaka.
column9: Synchronized deadline reminder flow, automated approval, and cleaned up warnings after resolution

column5: Review and approve recovery proposals (plan adjustments, deadline extensions) submitted by Mangakas when schedule delay risks occur. Includes submission history log.
Personal profile page for the editor, displaying avatar, nickname, contact email, key performance cards (ratings, followers, active series, completed works), biography, and recent activity log.
Configure account information, edit contact email, system language configurations, dark/light theme options, and profile privacy preferences.
